name: 02 Meta Ads daily sync -> analytics DB

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ad_daily (stat_date, creative_id, spend, impressions, clicks, frequency_7d, lp_views, lp_bounces, lp_load_ms)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 0, 0)
ON CONFLICT (stat_date, creative_id) DO UPDATE SET
  spend = EXCLUDED.spend, impressions = EXCLUDED.impressions, clicks = EXCLUDED.clicks,
  frequency_7d = EXCLUDED.frequency_7d, lp_views = EXCLUDED.lp_views;
-- lp_bounces and lp_load_ms are filled by workflow 03 from website analytics

-- Reconciliation: Meta's account total for yesterday must match what we stored (within Rs 1)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(spend)) AS stored_spend FROM ad_daily WHERE stat_date = CURRENT_DATE - 1;

meta.note: Prototype export. Credentials are placeholders. Not yet run against a live Meta ad account.
